description: Fondazione IPRES publishes puglia municipal vehicle stock, 2017–2024. Municipal vehicle counts cover 2017–2024 and distinguish passenger cars, buses, freight trucks, specialised vehicles, motorcycles, trailers, semi-trailers and road tractors. ACI is the underlying data source. The workbook descriptor extends to 2024, while the CSV descriptor ends in 2023; identical temporal coverage across formats is not assumed. Coverage is the Puglia region of Italy. The native catalogue provides CSV and spreadsheet distributions, with some linked visualisations. These alternative representations remain one resource; file contents and data rows were not inspected. The native licence is Creative Commons Attribution without a stated version. The national metadata mirror specifies version 4.0; the native statement remains unversioned. Metadata access is public, while file-use charges and restrictions are not established. Completeness and numerical accuracy are unverified. No specific simulation use is assigned.
